title: ConnectionCredentialExpiryReminderRequestedPayload
description: Payload of the ConnectionCredentialExpiryReminderRequested platform event (class: platform; INV-REQ-837). masterdata-svc and transport-svc publish it when a connection credential is offsetDays days from expiry; notification-svc consumes it. The recipients are routing data of the sender (INV-T-12928), not payload; it carries no person, address or credential. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

connection.description: The connection whose credential expires, e.g. an outbound feed or adapter name (same meaning as in ConnectionStatusChanged).

offsetDays.description: How many days before expiry this reminder is raised.
